files.content: # Countdown recipe ## Look in one paragraph Live coverage of a single event with a known zero. Screen time is event time. Bottom left: a T- clock that ticks every whole second. Bottom right: a live transcript that types itself. Above them: the picture, which splits into more hard-edged cells the nearer zero gets, all cells showing the same second. Every split lands on a spoken call. At zero the cells merge into one shot with a warm flash, and the clock block inverts from dark with an orange T- to orange with a dark T+. ## Ground rules - Time: one continuous stretch of the event. No cuts, no reordering, no speed-up. One formula for the whole film: event time = screen time - T0. The example puts zero at 11.5 s of a 15 s piece. Any frame must let a viewer check clock against picture. - The clock leads. It ticks each second, shows who holds control (control strip) and changes state at zero. - Every cell shows the same second. If one does not, label it (sync badge). - The layout is the edit. A cut is a layout change, and it lands on a call: a spoken line, a count, a visible event. Never on a music beat. - Cell count is the tension curve: 1, then 2, then 3-4, then one at zero. A few cells may return after zero to show consequences. - Real use: put the user's footage and photos (`list_media` paths) in a `

# Countdown screen: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 1.5, medium 2, long 3.

## hook

- en: one live camera fills the frame under a title plate wiped in from the left; the T− clock below ticks every second
- id: satu kamera langsung penuh layar dengan pelat judul tersapu dari kiri; jam T– di bawah berdetak tiap detik

## problem

- en: a second camera opens from its left edge on the call that names the trouble; its badge says if it is not frame-synced
- id: kamera kedua membuka dari tepi kirinya saat masalahnya disebut; lencananya jujur bila belum sinkron

## fact

- en: a new cell opens on the spoken call with a 3 px orange flash; the control strip hands over to whoever is in charge
- id: sel baru membuka tepat pada panggilannya dengan kilat bingkai oranye; strip kendali pindah ke yang memegang komando

## step

- en: an orange event flag slides in under the camera that shows it, on its call, and holds for its reading time
- id: bendera peristiwa oranye meluncur di bawah kamera yang memperlihatkannya, tepat pada panggilannya, lalu diam

## compare

- en: two bars from one zero line, the subject in orange and the other grey; a dashed marker and the % difference
- id: dua batang dari satu garis nol, subjek oranye dan pembanding abu; garis putus-putus dan selisih persennya

## number

- en: a data cell pushes the main camera up; its bar unrolls while the figure counts up to the real value
- id: sel data mendorong kamera utama ke atas; batangnya terbuka sambil angkanya menghitung ke nilai asli

## proof

- en: a photo cell of the people, pushing in under 6%, their names popping on plates one by one 0.16 s apart
- id: sel foto orang-orangnya, mendorong pelan di bawah 6%, nama muncul di pelat satu per satu berjarak 0,16 detik

## offer

- en: the offer rides an event flag or the title plate over the live picture while the clock keeps running
- id: penawaran tampil di bendera peristiwa atau pelat judul di atas gambar langsung, jam tetap berjalan

## cta

- en: at zero every cell merges into one shot with a warm flash, the clock flips to orange T+; name and contact held 2 s
- id: di nol semua sel menyatu jadi satu gambar dengan kilat hangat, jam berbalik oranye T+; nama dan kontak diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: zero: the cells merge into the one picture of the moment, the clock inverts and counts up; the result held 2 s
- id: nol: sel menyatu jadi satu gambar momennya, jam terbalik dan menghitung naik; hasilnya diam 2 detik

<script>
const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id), qa = (s, p = document) => [...p.querySelectorAll(s)];
const css = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement), K = (n) => css.getPropertyValue("--fs-" + n).trim();
const Z = 11.5, END = 15; // nol di detik 11,5: waktu layar = waktu peristiwa
const rnd = ((a) => () => { a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0; let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a); t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t; return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296; })(140626);

// ===== 1. Gambar kamera pengganti, dilukis sekali di Canvas 2D dengan satu grade, lalu jadi <img>.
//      Di video sungguhan sel berisi footage dan foto pengguna (list_media). =====
let x; // konteks kanvas yang sedang dilukis
const A = (n, a) => { const v = parseInt(K(n).slice(1), 16); return `rgba(${v >> 16},${(v >> 8) & 255},${v & 255},${a})`; }; // token + alfa
const G = (x0, y0, x1, y1, ...st) => { const g = x.createLinearGradient(x0, y0, x1, y1); st.forEach((c, i) => g.addColorStop(i / (st.length - 1), c)); return g; };
const F = (c, ...r) => { x.fillStyle = c; x.fillRect(...r); };
const E = (c, cx, cy, rx, ry, a = 0, b = 7) => { x.fillStyle = c; x.beginPath(); x.ellipse(cx, cy, rx, ry, 0, a, b); x.fill(); };
const S = (c, lw, segs) => { x.strokeStyle = c; x.lineWidth = lw; x.beginPath(); segs.forEach(([a, b, d, e]) => { x.moveTo(a, b); x.lineTo(d, e); }); x.stroke(); };
const Q = (c, pts) => { x.fillStyle = c; x.beginPath(); pts.forEach(([a, b]) => x.lineTo(a, b)); x.fill(); };
function paint(w, h, draw) {
  const c = Object.assign(document.createElement("canvas"), { width: w, height: h });
  const soft = (r) => { const t = Object.assign(document.createElement("canvas"), { width: w, height: h }); t.getContext("2d").drawImage(c, 0, 0); x.filter = `blur(${r}px)`; x.drawImage(t, 0, 0); x.filter = "none"; };
  x = c.getContext("2d"); draw(w, h, soft); soft(0.9); // lunak seperti video
  x.globalCompositeOperation = "soft-light"; F(G(0, 0, 0, h, A("krem", 0.3), A("spanduk", 0.35)), 0, 0, w, h); // sorot hangat, bayang dingin
  x.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
  const v = x.createRadialGradient(w / 2, h * 0.45, h * 0.3, w / 2, h * 0.45, Math.hypot(w, h) * 0.6);
  v.addColorStop(0, A("hitam", 0)); v.addColorStop(1, A("hitam", 0.36)); F(v, 0, 0, w, h); // vinyet ke 36%
